description: Protected frames of four raw data blocks each: the header's CRC covers the header and the block positions, and each block ends in a CRC over its single channel element's first 192 bits.

skip.faad_trace: faad2 reads one raw data block per ADTS frame.
skip.ffprobe_streams: ffmpeg 6.1 does not decode ADTS frames of several protected raw data blocks, so it reports no sample rate.
